title: Luz Brillosa | KEY.co
description_expanded: Luz Brillosa Hideaway is a stunning 985 sq. ft. retreat that blends natural elegance with modern luxury, offering a serene escape with breathtaking views of both the Atlantic Ocean and Intracoastal Waterway. The private, furnished balcony invites relaxation with a double chaise lounge and an intimate dining set for two, perfect for enjoying sunrises or evening breezes. Inside, the living room features a plush organic sofa that effortlessly converts into a bed, while the sleek maple dining table creates a warm, inviting space for meals or conversation. The master bedroom at Luz Brillosa Hideaway is a true sanctuary, boasting a king-sized Keetsa mattress adorned with 100% organic cotton sheets, ensuring ultimate comfort and rest. Every detail, from the clean, minimalist design to the organic materials, has been thoughtfully curated to create a tranquil yet luxurious atmosphere. Whether you're enjoying the natural beauty outside or the cozy comfort indoors, this home offers the perfect setting for a rejuvenating getaway.
